name: confirmatory Colosseum test of OEH current (fresh MDPs)
motivation: exploratory run (32 MDPs) gave OEH vs B2 Brier GO and log-loss lower bound -0.021; its effect (mean log-loss gain 0.089, MDP-level SE about 0.062) implies about 50 MDPs for a positive simultaneous bound; 72 are used

mdps.source: Colosseum (Conserva & Rauber, NeurIPS 2022), authors' sample_mdp_parameters, continuous setting
mdps.exclusion: any kernel identical to the 32 exploratory MDPs
mdps.selection: first 18 per family in sampler order -> 72 MDPs (fewer only if a family runs out; reported)

unchanged_from_exploratory: project generator, 5 behaviors, pilot x10, 10 training seeds, BC/CFQI/IQL hyper-parameters, label rule
forecaster: sealed seven-cohort meta-training via expanded_meta; no refit choices, no tuning
comparators: oeh_final (108), b2_matched (18), b2_plus_colosseum (B2 + log diameter, value norm, log gaps)
team's documented expectile fix applied only where the archived IQL raises
metrics, MDP-level aggregation, 10,000 whole-MDP bootstrap, simultaneous max-t one-sided 95% bounds

gate.primary: OEH vs b2_matched: mean gain > 0 and simultaneous lower bound > 0 for BOTH integrated Brier and seven-class log loss

reporting: report GO or NO-GO as computed; descriptive analyses (family, learner, finite vs censored, posterior-draw failures) do not change the verdict; no re-run on these MDPs after outcomes
